entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Cover a Companion

*The guardian steps into the line of danger, making the attacker work around its raised guard.*

Before a visible enemy attacks a willing ally adjacent to this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll if this creature can see the attacker. Against an NPC attack, grant that ally 1 Boon to its defense instead. This creature must also be adjacent to the attacker, or hold a shield the DA judges can obstruct the attack. No movement, target substitution or damage transfer. For a single player area attack, use the normal worst-target modifiers; do not roll again.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Construct: ordinary HP healing does not repair it; destroyed at 0. Combat repair requires an explicit repair ability. Workshop repair remains a design question.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Dust ends in a clean crescent around the display plinth.

**Purpose:** Guard the boundary encoded in its command plate.

**Tactics and retreat:** Hold the narrowest entrance and use Shield Hunker.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Read or remove the command plate through a deliberate interaction, not an automatic combat shutdown.

**Habitat:** Vault; hall · **Communication:** Understands the maker’s language

**Loot:** An ordinary shield and armor shell; repairing the shell does not grant an animated servant.

**Summoning:** Construct 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/animated-armor.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-animated-armor


**Category:** Construct · **Role:** Guard · **CV:** 18

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.3

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.2 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=3.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Cover a Companion](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/cover-a-companion.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [shield hunker](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/shield-hunker.md).
